title: 第42章 破而后立，请你冷静点！
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “周凯东，你这班长到底是怎么当的，还想不想当了？”走廊尽头，何镇涛指着周凯东鼻子就开骂。陆阳是他最喜欢，也是最看好的兵。现在却因为周凯东的疏忽卧病在床，他怎么可能不生气？周凯东自知理亏，主动承认过失：“指导员，这件事确实是我疏忽。我当时发现苗头不对，就给他冲了板蓝根，没想到会突然加重......”“没想到，没想到，你没想到的事太多了！”何镇涛气不打一处来：“陆阳什么身体素质，你应该很清楚，瘦瘦弱弱风吹就倒！”“发现苗头不对，还让他继续训练？你难道不知道发热出汗，毛孔打开反而会加重病情？”“新兵蛋子不知道就算了，你这个老兵怎么总是犯一些个低级错误？”周凯东被唾沫星子喷了一脸，根本抬不起头。原本因为丁腾飞的事，他已经很懊悔了。现如今陆阳也因自已疏忽倒下，让他内心更加自责。何镇涛也意识到先前那番话说的有些重了，语气稍稍放缓了些。“周凯东，虽然新兵连是临时组建的单位，我不是你老部队的指导员，但有些话我还是希望你们听进去。”“以你目前的表现来看，新训结束评优评选大概率和你无缘了，但你也不能破罐子破摔。”“这两天你的表现我都看在眼里，消极怠工，自由散漫，哪有一丁点当班排长的样子？”“你这样下去不行的，不光是糊弄自已，更是对这些新兵的极不负责。”“知道了，指导员，我会努力调整状态。”周凯东开口保证，但话语里却听不到他的决心。何镇涛无奈叹气，有些话点到为止就行了，能不能听得进去得看他自已。这个兵并不是他的直属下级，新兵连也是个临时组建的单位，他不想说太多免得招人烦。“一会跟我去办公室，我那儿有退烧药，先给陆阳吃两颗。”“如果晚上还不退烧，我得开车带他去团里医务室挂水。”“正好通知你一下，明后天野战医院的流动体检车会开到团部，给团领导和军属做统一体检，顺带给新兵做个复检。”“具体时间等通知，到时会有车过来接；你回头负责通知其他班长，今明两天别练太狠，适当调整作息。”“是。”新兵复检通常在入伍一个月以内。以往都是坐大巴车去市医院体检中心接受检查。流程和征兵体检差不多，主要是检查有无重大疾病。这回，野战医院直接把流动体检车开到团里来，正好省的他们外出跑一趟了。正好，指导员还能带去给陆阳挂个急诊，让野战医院的大夫专家帮忙看看。团医务室那帮家伙卫生员专业是战地急救，手法相当粗鲁，跟兽医有的一拼。前两年，周凯东有个战友在团比武时甲沟炎犯了。去到医务室，有个家伙竟直接用老虎钳子把他指甲拔了。美其名曰，没有甲床，甲沟炎就不会再反反复复。结果这一钳子下去，直接干废了一个长跑王。当时，气的他们连长扛着40火就要跟那庸医拼命。不过好在，今回有野战医院的专家坐镇，再加上指导员本身在团里也有一定人脉关系，周凯东也就不用跟着后头操心了。周凯东回到宿舍叮嘱了一声，便跟着指导员去他办公室拿药了。此时，昏睡中的陆阳已经因为高烧，开始说起胡话。“王姐，真不能再喝了，再喝得加钱......”“传统的五子棋，就是把五个子连成一条线......”“敌军不是十五万，是十五万零两个，你有六个诸葛亮......”三班新兵像是小矮人围着白马王子那样，大眼瞪小眼的聚在床边，看着嘀嘀咕咕说胡话的陆阳表情相当怪异。“这都什么跟什么啊，驴头驴对马？”“孔垄，你说班副会不会把脑袋烧坏，变得跟你一样？”“滚一边去，你才大傻子呢！”孔垄灵机一动，说自已有个法子，能让陆阳赶紧好起来。丁腾飞冷不丁的来了句：“怎么，你家不开饭馆，改医馆了？”孔垄白了他一眼，再次说起东北地区绕不开的民风民俗，出马。对于玄而又玄的东西，大家全都表现出强烈的好奇和求知欲望。尽管都知道，这些并没有科学依据，但架不住就是想听，就是感兴趣。“我妈说我八岁那年高烧不退，我外婆就拿了个镜子，用硬币在上头敲；边敲，边喊我名字.....”“后来你就好了？”“那倒没有，后来去医院挂水挂好的。”“那你说个屁啊！”“活跃一下气氛不行吗？”忽然，床上一直昏睡的陆阳，迷迷糊糊的睁开了眼。他是硬生生被这帮家伙给吵醒的，乱哄哄的就跟开茶话会似的。“几点了？”“下午四点半了。”“班副，你感觉怎么样，好点儿了吗？”“要不要喝点儿水，吃点东西？”孔垄拿了个枕头，垫在陆阳背后，将他可以半躺着。坐起后的陆阳脑袋已经沉甸甸，像是灌了水泥。先前中午，他吃了点班长带回来的稀饭和小咸菜，这会儿没啥胃口，也不想吃东西。看着四周一张张关心自已的脸，陆阳心想这兵是真没白当。前世每天为了生计奔波，回来倒头就睡，也没个朋友。怕父母担心，感冒发烧了从不和家里说，都是硬扛过去。尤其是那种一个人昏昏沉沉的躺在出租屋，明明只想睡个午觉，醒来后天已然黑透的孤独感，远比生病要难受的多。好在，这一世陆阳选了一条不同的路，而他也逐渐喜欢上了部队的氛围。“好多了。”陆阳略显苍白的脸上挂着点儿微笑：“班长呢，这个点你们怎么没训练？”“才搞完器械，回来看看你。班长刚被指导员叫出去，好像还被臭骂了一顿。”孔垄的话让陆阳倍感无奈。之前他总是戏称，说这个班没有自已迟早得散。现如今，他是真觉得，已经逐步开始有这个征兆了。三班总共就这个八九个人，两个不合群，一个脑袋不好，一个病号。尤其这俩不合群的还相互之间闹别扭，简直乱七八糟，光是想想陆阳就头疼的厉害。倒不是他这个班副，硬要操班干部的心，而是夹在中间实在别扭。就像三个盆友，有两个闹矛盾，夹在中间的那个指定难受。此外，班长的消极情绪，也严重影响到陆阳的学习进度。所以，陆阳才得想法子给这个结解开，不然新兵连三个月他恐怕难以达到预期要求。地基夯不牢，往后就没法一步步滚雪球；堂哥的经验告诉他一步走错，步步走错，陆阳可不想步入他的后尘。“喔......呜！”可偏偏就在这时，一阵强烈的眩晕感袭来。陆阳像是吃了毒菌子，眼前开始天旋地转。同时胃里翻涌，一股酸水直接从食道冲进口腔，让他忍不住想要呕吐。看出陆阳好像是想吐，众人立马手忙脚乱，孔垄一把拿过自已的茶缸子递过去。陆阳把茶缸子推开，强忍着难受，摇摇晃晃的爬起来准备去厕所吐。他也是个要面子的人，这种天气吐在宿舍里气味可想而知，回头还怎么住人？可陆阳刚下床，就被一道身影挡住去路，紧跟着一只小黄盆就递到他面前。“就吐里头，一会我去倒了！”陆阳本想抬头，可在强烈的眩晕感刺激下，实在没忍住抱着小黄盆就呕了出来。原本中午就吃的不多，这下子直接把胃里都清空了。陆阳吐得一把鼻涕一把泪，吐到最后只剩胆汁，却还在不停的干呕，像是要把胃也从嘴里吐出来才罢休。孔垄连忙递过来一杯温水给他漱口，同时拍拍他的背。陆阳吐完，感觉整个人都舒服多了，身体似乎也更轻了。重新躺回床上，看着那个端着小黄盆面的丁腾飞，陆阳说了声感谢。“尼玛，吐特么老子手上了！”“但凡不是病号，我都得逼你重新吃下去！”陆阳笑了，但凡手头有卷胶带纸，他都得给这家伙把嘴粘上。这家伙是要么不说话，要么嘴巴就跟淬了毒似的。就在这时，眼前一道光幕弹出，依旧是友情提示。【当宿主突发性的处于生病，受伤，濒死等极端情况下可触发“破而后立”效果，康复后身体素质将得到相应程度的改善提升！】不破不立，破而后立？陆阳这个效果很意思，有点儿像洗筋伐髓。都是经历一些身体上的痛苦，出汗排垢，然后获得进步提升。“那，如果我多烧个两天，是不是提升效果更明显？”“......”“要是我把腿打折了，康复了是不是能跑更快？假设，往腰子上扎两刀，有没有可能......？”“宿主，系统劝你冷静，一定要冷静！”
content_en: "Zhou Kaidong, how did you become the squad leader? Do you still want to be the squad leader?" At the end of the corridor, He Zhentao pointed at Zhou Kaidong's nose and cursed.Lu Yang was his favorite and most optimistic soldier.Now he is bedridden because of Zhou Kaidong's negligence. How could he not be angry?Zhou Kaidong knew that he was wrong and took the initiative to admit his fault: "Instructor, this matter was indeed my negligence. I noticed something was wrong at that time, so I gave him Isatis root. I didn't expect that it would suddenly worsen..." "I didn't expect, I didn't expect, there are so many things you didn't expect!" He Zhentao was furious: "What's Lu Yang's physical fitness? What should you do?"You should know very well that if you are thin and weak, you will fall if the wind blows!" "You still let him continue training when you find something wrong?Don't you know that being hot and sweating will make the condition worse?" "Forget it, you are a veteran.Why do you, a veteran, always make stupid mistakes?" Zhou Kaidong was sprayed with saliva and couldn't lift his head at all.He was already very regretful because of what happened to Ding Tengfei.Now Lu Yang also fell down due to his own negligence, which made him blame himself even more.He Zhentao also realized that his previous words were a bit harsh, so he softened his tone slightly."Zhou Kaidong, although the recruit company is a temporarily formed unit, and I am not the instructor of your old unit, there are some words I still hope you will listen to." "Judging from your current performance, there is a high probability that you will not be selected for the selection after the new training, but you can't fail." "I have paid attention to your performance in the past two days.In his eyes, he is passive and slack, and he doesn't look like a platoon leader at all."You can't continue like this. Not only are you fooling yourself, but you are also extremely irresponsible to these recruits.""I understand, instructor, I will try my best to adjust the situation."Zhou Kaidong promised, but there was no determination in his words.He Zhentao sighed helplessly. He just had to stop talking about some words. Whether he could listen to them or not was up to him.This soldier is not his direct subordinate. The recruit company is also a temporary unit. He doesn't want to say too much to avoid annoying people."Follow me to the office later. I have fever-reducing medicine there. Give Lu Yang two pills first." "If the fever doesn't subside by night, I have to drive him to the regiment infirmary to get some fluids." "I just want to inform you that the mobile medical examination vehicle from the field hospital will drive to the regiment headquarters tomorrow and give it to the regiment leaders.Do a physical examination with the military family members and give the recruits a re-examination."We will wait for the specific time and a car will come to pick him up. You will be responsible for notifying other squad leaders today and tomorrow. Don't practice too hard today and adjust your schedule appropriately.""Yes, the recruits are usually re-examined within one month of joining the army."In the past, I would take a bus to the physical examination center of the city hospital for examination.The process is similar to the physical examination for military conscription, mainly checking for major diseases.This time, the field hospital drove the mobile medical examination vehicle directly to the group, which saved them a trip.Fortunately, the instructor could also take Lu Yang to the emergency department and let the doctors and experts from the field hospital help take a look.The hygienists in the regimental infirmary specialize in field first aid, and their methods are quite rough, comparable to those of veterinarians.Two years ago, one of Zhou Kaidong's comrades suffered from paronychia during a regiment competition.When he went to the infirmary, a guy pulled out his nails with a vise.As the name suggests, without the nail bed, paronychia will not come back again and again.As a result, this pliers went down and killed a long-distance running king.At that time, their company commander was so angry that he had to fight the quack doctor with 40 pieces of fire.Fortunately, there are experts from the field hospital on duty this time, and the instructor himself has certain connections in the regiment, so Zhou Kaidong doesn't have to worry about it.Zhou Kaidong returned to the dormitory and gave instructions, then followed the instructor to his office to get medicine.At this time, Lu Yang, who was sleeping, had already started talking nonsense due to high fever."Sister Wang, I really can't drink anymore. If you drink any more, you'll have to pay extra..." "Traditional backgammon is to connect five pieces in a line..." "The enemy's army is not 150,000, but 150,000 and two, and you have six Zhuge Liang..." The recruits from the third class gathered around the bed like dwarfs surrounding Prince Charming, with big eyes and small eyes. They looked at Lu Yang, who was mumbling nonsense, with a weird expression."What are they talking about, a donkey's head versus a horse?" "Kong Long, do you think the class vice president will burn out his head and become like you?" "Get out of here, you're such a fool!" Kong Long had an idea and said that he had a way to help Lu Yang get better quickly.Ding Tengfei said abruptly: "Why, your family doesn't open a restaurant, but a medical clinic?" Kong Long rolled his eyes at him, and once again talked about the unavoidable folk customs in the Northeast, he took action.Everyone showed strong curiosity and desire for knowledge about mysterious and mysterious things.Although everyone knows that there is no scientific basis for these, they can’t help but want to listen and are interested."My mother said that when I was eight years old, I had a high fever, so my grandma took a mirror and knocked it with coins; while she was knocking, she called my name..." "You got better later?" "That's not true. Later, I went to the hospital to hang a water hook." "Then what are you talking about?" "Can't we liven up the atmosphere?" Suddenly, Lu Yang, who had been sleeping on the bed, opened his eyes drowsily.He was woken up abruptly by these guys, making the scene as noisy as a tea party."What time is it?" "It's four-thirty in the afternoon." "Deputy deputy, how are you feeling? Are you feeling better?" "Would you like some water and something to eat?" Kong Long took a pillow and put it behind Lu Yang so that he could half lie down.After sitting up, Lu Yang's head felt as heavy as cement.At noon, he ate some porridge and pickles brought back by the monitor. Now he had no appetite and didn't want to eat.Looking at the concerned faces around him, Lu Yang thought to himself that this soldier was really not in vain.In my previous life, I was running around for a living every day. When I came back, I fell asleep and had no friends.Afraid of worrying my parents, I never tell my family if I have a cold or fever, I just carry it through.Especially the feeling of loneliness when a person is lying in a rental house in a daze, obviously just want to take a nap, but when he wakes up and the day after tomorrow is already dark, it is far more uncomfortable than being sick.Fortunately, Lu Yang chose a different path in this life, and he gradually fell in love with the atmosphere of the army."Much better." There was a smile on Lu Yang's slightly pale face: "Where's the squad leader, why haven't you trained at this point?" "I just finished getting the equipment, and I came back to see you. The squad leader was just called out by the instructor, and he seemed to have been scolded." Kong Long's words made Lu Yang feel helpless.He always joked before that this class would have to disperse sooner or later.Now, he really feels that this sign has gradually begun to appear.There are only eight or nine people in the third class, two are unsociable, one has a bad head, and one is sick.Especially since these two misfits were at odds with each other, it was such a mess that Lu Yang had a severe headache just thinking about it.It's not that he, the class deputy, insists on taking advantage of the class cadres, but it's just that it's awkward to be caught in the middle.Just like three friends, two of them are in conflict, and the one in the middle is definitely uncomfortable.In addition, the monitor's negative mood also seriously affected Lu Yang's learning progress.Therefore, Lu Yang had to find a way to untie this knot, otherwise he might not be able to meet the expected requirements for recruits for three consecutive months.If the foundation is not firmly laid, it will be impossible to snowball step by step in the future; his cousin's experience tells him that he will make the wrong step, and Lu Yang does not want to follow in his footsteps."Oh...woo!" But just at this moment, a strong feeling of dizziness came over him.Lu Yang seemed to have eaten poisonous mushrooms, and his eyes began to spin.At the same time, his stomach was churning, and a stream of acidic water rushed directly from his esophagus into his mouth, making him want to vomit.Seeing that Lu Yang seemed to want to vomit, everyone was immediately in a hurry. Kong Rong took his teapot and handed it over.Lu Yang pushed the teapot away, endured the discomfort, and got up unsteadily to go to the toilet to vomit.He is also a person who cares about face. You can imagine the smell of vomit in the dormitory in this weather. How can he live in it again?But as soon as Lu Yang got out of bed, he was blocked by a figure, and then a small yellow basin was handed to him."Just spit it out, I'll pour it out after a while!" Lu Yang wanted to raise his head, but under the stimulation of strong dizziness, he couldn't help but vomited out while holding the small yellow basin.I didn't eat much at noon, but now I emptied my stomach.Lu Yang vomited until he had snot and tears. In the end, only bile was left, but he kept retching, as if he wanted to vomit his stomach out of his mouth.Kong Rong quickly handed him a glass of warm water to rinse his mouth, and patted his back at the same time.After Lu Yang finished vomiting, he felt much better and his body seemed lighter.Lying back on the bed and looking at Ding Tengfei holding the small yellow bowl of noodles, Lu Yang said thank you."Damn it, I've got it on my hands!" "As long as it's not a sick person, I have to force you to eat again!" Lu Yang smiled, as long as he had a roll of tape on hand, he would have to tape this guy's mouth.This guy either doesn't speak, or his mouth seems to be quenched with poison.At this moment, a light screen popped up in front of him, still a friendly reminder.[When the host is suddenly sick, injured, near death and other extreme situations, the "break and then stand" effect can be triggered. After recovery, the physical fitness will be improved accordingly!】If you don’t destroy it, you won’t establish it. If you destroy it, you can establish it later?Lu Yang, this effect is very interesting, a bit like washing the tendons and cutting the marrow.They all experience some physical pain, sweat and remove dirt, and then make progress."Then, if I burn for two more days, will the improvement effect be more obvious?" "..." "If I break my leg, will I be able to run faster after recovery? Hypothetically, if I stab my waist twice, is it possible...?" "Host, the system advises you to calm down, be sure to calm down!"
